responsibility: Implements C++ front-end lexical-side initialization and language-specific node attachment around the shared preprocessor lexer. It initializes overloaded-operator identifier tables and pragma handling, supports #pragma interface/implementation bookkeeping, allocates and duplicates C++ lang_decl/lang_type data for declarations and types, creates C++ type nodes with interface flags, and provides identifier-kind and input-context helpers used by parser and name-lookup code.
